raw_comment: Some things I noticed is that the driest areas tend to be in the mid-west section of the country. I wonder what the science behind it all is. Recently PA has been very dry and needing water for our lawns and vegetation, but if PA is one of the less dry places on the map, then I wonder what its like in Wyoming and Texas where the extreme drought is. A catchy title for this graph could be, "Hopefully Rain will be Pouring, Maybe Even and Old Man Will Snore."
